206:t_1:86.en:
$$佐伯$$
「What are you saying? This is about more than one company's survival now.」

206:t_1:87.en:
$$赤木$$
「We'll give it our all, us and $$ダイ・ガード$$, to keep that from happening.」

206:t_1:88.en:
$$青山$$
「Right. At this point, our jobs don't matter. Everyone on Earth has to fight together.」

206:t_1:89.en:
$$いぶき$$
「But while that's fine for us adults...」

206:t_1:90.en:
$$赤木$$
「What about $$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$ and the others... and everyone at $$陣代高校$$...?」

206:t_1:91.en:
$$佐伯$$
「The battles ahead will likely be fiercer than anything we've faced so far.」

206:t_1:92.en:
$$佐伯$$
「They'll probably have to take leave from school to join the fighting.」

206:t_1:93.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So that's the end of $$宗介$$'s high school life.」

206:t_1:94.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Everyone in the Volunteer Club... They've somehow balanced both lives until now, but they've finally reached their limit...」

206:t_1:95.en:
$$マオ$$
「...It's a shame, but we have no choice. Miss $$スズネ$$'s teaching practice at $$陣代高校$$ will end soon too...」

206:t_1:96.en:
$$青山$$
「$$陣代高校$$... I hear their third-term closing ceremony is tomorrow.」

206:t_1:97.en:
$$葵$$
「So the Volunteer Club members will be transferring after spring break.」

206:t_1:98.en:
$$朔哉$$
「...What are $$甲児$$ and the others doing?」

206:t_1:99.en:
$$大山$$
「Everyone except $$宗介$$ and $n is at the base servicing their machines.」

206:t_1:100.en:
$$中原$$
「Those two seem to have gone to school.」

206:t_1:102.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Those two... were especially attached to the school...」

206:t_1:103.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...It can't be helped. With things the way they are.」

206:t_1:104.en:
$$マオ$$
「I don't know about $n, but $$宗介$$ is just going back to his old life.」

206:t_1:105.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Although he's not the boy he used to be...」

206:t_1:106.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We'll have to leave guarding $$カナメ$$ to the intelligence people.」

206:t_1:107.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$宗介$$ and $n... I hope they can come to terms with it...」

206:t_1:108.en:
$$赤木$$
($$シンジ$$... I hear the Volunteer Club is coming to an end too...)

206:t_1:109.en:
$$赤木$$
(But we won't give up... We'll work to bring back a world where $$宗介$$ and the others can go to school again...)

206:t_1:110.en:
$$赤木$$
(So you keep trying too... Wherever you are, you're a Volunteer Club member, and part of $c...)

206:t_1:115.en:
$$林水$$
「...I'm sorry, $$相良$$. I've taken up your time when you've only just returned to school.」

206:t_1:116.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, sir... Congratulations on your graduation, Council President, sir.」

206:t_1:117.en:
$$林水$$
「That title needs a 'former' now. With graduation approaching, I have to entrust the post to my successor.」

206:t_1:118.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll call you Former Council President, sir.」

206:t_1:119.en:
$$林水$$
「...What will you do? Will you remain the council president's aide for security affairs under the new student council?」

206:t_1:122.en:
$$林水$$
「Where are the Volunteer Club members today?」

206:t_1:123.en:
$$宗介$$
「They're busy finishing work from our recent activities, so I'm the only one attending school today.」

206:t_1:124.en:
$$林水$$
「Then let's get to the reason I called you here.」

206:t_1:126.en:
$$林水$$
「It's been a year since you... all of you came to $$陣代高校$$... Much has happened, from minor disturbances to serious, grave incidents.」

206:t_1:127.en:
$$林水$$
「I've avoided prying into your connection to those events, and tried to help whenever you needed it.」

206:t_1:128.en:
$$林水$$
「I also took the liberty of helping with Miss $$スズネ$$'s activity reports to the school, as student council president.」

206:t_1:130.en:
$$林水$$
「I had no ulterior motive. I meant it simply as a kindness to friends.」

206:t_1:131.en:
$$林水$$
「But... I think it's becoming impossible.」

206:t_1:133.en:
$$林水$$
「Of the Volunteer Club members, you've learned especially well how to fit into our society, and grown a great deal.」

206:t_1:134.en:
$$林水$$
「As things stood through the fall, I thought continued effort would be enough.」

206:t_1:135.en:
$$林水$$
「But the state of the world is making that impossible... No, I should say it already has.」

206:t_1:136.en:
$$林水$$
「And the person who will become the greatest problem in all this is her... $$千鳥$$.」

206:t_1:138.en:
$$林水$$
「She's at the center of it. Every truly serious incident at $$陣代高校$$, without exception...」

206:t_1:139.en:
$$林水$$
「At first I thought her father's position as the $$地球連邦$$'s High Commissioner for the Environment was the cause, but that doesn't explain it.」

206:t_1:140.en:
$$林水$$
「The other factor is your absence during those incidents and the $$地球連邦軍$$ special unit called $c...」

206:t_1:142.en:
$$林水$$
「I don't intend to pry any further, but I think it's only a matter of time before other people raise a fuss.」

206:t_1:143.en:
$$林水$$
「And Miss $$スズネ$$ and I will both be gone next month. We won't be able to help you as before.」

206:t_1:144.en:
$$林水$$
「Events will inevitably accelerate as the world changes... Time is running out... You should talk to her.」

206:t_1:145.en:
$$林水$$
「Otherwise... you'll be tormented by terrible regret afterward.」

206:t_1:147.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not the only one. $n, $$アルト$$, $$甲児$$, everyone does...」

206:t_1:148.en:
$$林水$$
「...So do I. They're all lovable people... They're simple and kind, but they're still ordinary human beings.」

206:t_1:149.en:
$$林水$$
「They feel fear and anxiety. And... they can become cruel.」

206:t_1:151.en:
$$林水$$
「...But perhaps it isn't something to despair over. This is only a school, after all... A way station.」

206:t_1:153.en:
$$林水$$
「It's easy to forget... but life goes on. For decades to come.」

206:t_1:160.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Hey, $$相良$$. Finished the former council president's final lecture?」

206:t_1:161.en:
$$風間$$
「You were gone quite a while. Morning classes are already over.」

206:t_1:162.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「This afternoon, we're preparing for tomorrow's closing ceremony. Basically, our last class of second year is over.」

206:t_1:165.en:
$$詩織$$
「You've missed so much school, I think it's a little late for that...」

206:t_1:166.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「So, aren't $$アルト$$ and the others coming today?」

206:t_1:168.en:
$$詩織$$
「That's a problem... Everyone seems to have lots they want the Volunteer Club to do over spring break...」

206:t_1:169.en:
$$恭子$$
「I wanted to give $$アルト$$ and $n the Valentine's chocolates I've been holding for them too...」

206:t_1:170.en:
$$風間$$
「$$兜$$ promised to treat me to $$銀河ラーメン$$ too...」

206:t_1:171.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Forget that, what about Miss $$スズネ$$?! Her special teaching practice is nearly over, and we can't even say goodbye?!」

206:t_1:140: Hayashimizu lists factors without closing his inference, preserving deliberate ambiguity.
206:t_1:152: Sousuke repeats way station as an echo question.

Hayashimizu warns Sousuke that Kaname is linked to every major incident and civilian protection is expiring; he encourages a conversation. Classmates unknowingly discuss the missed last school day. Literal school year and term retained.
